modules.title: Web Foundations
modules.description: The bedrock of every website: HTML structure, CSS presentation, and how browsers turn code into pixels. You will learn how the web works at a protocol level, how to author semantic documents, and how to style them with modern CSS including Flexbox and Grid.
topics: How the web really works (HTTP, DNS, browsers)

modules.title: JavaScript Essentials
modules.description: JavaScript is the language of the web. This module takes you from variables to closures, the event loop, and async programming. By the end you can build interactive UIs, fetch data from APIs, and reason confidently about how JS executes.

modules.title: Modern React
modules.description: React is the industry standard for building UIs. You will learn components, hooks, state, effects, context, and how to structure real applications. We also cover performance, suspense, and the latest React features.

modules.title: Python & Scripting
modules.description: Python is the Swiss army knife of programming. This module covers syntax, data structures, OOP, file I/O, decorators, generators, and how to build real CLI tools and automation scripts that save you hours every week.

modules.title: Backend & APIs
modules.description: Build real backends. You will learn REST, databases, authentication, and how to deploy. We use Node.js, Express, and Supabase to ship a production-grade API with row-level security and realtime subscriptions.

modules.title: Computer Science Core
modules.description: The theory that makes you a real engineer: data structures, algorithms, complexity, and problem-solving patterns. Essential for interviews and for writing code that scales beyond a toy app.
